notes.title: Version 1.02 is out!
notes.notes:
With 1.02, several new fixes have been made. The important ones include:
[list]
    [*]World 3's 'Mountain' level is now possible to complete. A fix to a object in a previous update broke how they worked when used in Mountain, causing the area inside it to not work.
    [*]World 1's Launch Ring Tutorial no longer has a puzzle that self-solves itself. The trigger area to reset the puzzle was set to "start puzzle" so it would begin when the player was not there yet.
    [*]Main menu's world 2 has two levels swapped. Giant pushblock intro and Seaside speedrun have swapped locations as Seaside speedrun contained giant pushblocks and could be confusing if players don't know what they do.
    [*]Main menu's Option menu no longer trigger buttons in the background. This means you can't click on the quit game button behind the menu.
    [*]A few back-end fixes. Nothing that will be seen by the player, but some users may see an increase in framerate.
[/list]

The issue for options menu not applying settings on startup will be in soon, the back-end fixes is a step forward for getting that working. It will take some time to fully add this feature in, but the Mountain issue had to be patched right away.

notes.title: Patch 1.01 comming soon with fixes to reported issues.
notes.notes: After release, there have been a couple of issues found in a couple of levels. They are in the process of being fixed and will be updated sometime this week. If you notice anything odd, check the known-issue list in the discussions section and if you find something not reported say something and it will be included for the next patch.
